status: PROPOSED ACCEPTANCE CONTRACT; not a completion claim or observed percentages
definition: 100% means every agreed acceptance criterion has dated evidence in the declared supported scope, not universal intelligence or guaranteed real-world success.

levels.name: Foundation / Agent Engine
levels.acceptance: Fresh install, schema migration, durable queue, bounded execution, cancellation, restart recovery and audit retention pass isolated tests and source-stable live smoke.

levels.name: Desktop + Runtime
levels.acceptance: Login/start/stop paths and independent task windows work; ownership-aware cleanup, minimize/maximize/fullscreen and background workers pass observed journeys; completed 48h observation with explicit coverage.

levels.name: Voice/Text to Actions
levels.acceptance: Text and actual microphone-to-answer tasks pass frozen English fixture; false wakes measured over stated duration; missing microphone means acoustic acceptance remains blocked.

levels.name: Safe Typed Capabilities
levels.acceptance: Every enabled effect has typed validation, enforced scope and approval, independent postcondition or explicit unconfirmed result; no undeclared writes in adversarial fixture.

levels.name: Goal Orchestrator
levels.acceptance: Both exemplar goals decompose through real entrypoint, acquire only authorized context, honor dependencies and root budgets, survive interruption and return partial/missing-source results honestly.

levels.name: Verification / Evidence
levels.acceptance: All important goal predicates bind to fresh provenance; injected lying tools cannot earn verified completion; coverage denominators and unknowns exposed; source-stable repeated end-to-end baseline.

levels.name: Context / Personal Adaptation
levels.acceptance: Relevant evidence selected within declared context budget; privacy/expiry/contradiction/deletion propagate; USER facts cannot be overwritten by learning; held-out retrieval and task quality nonregress.

levels.name: Proactive Intelligence
levels.acceptance: Connected event sources produce deduplicated prioritized proposals with opt-out, quiet hours, rate limits, expiry and bounded resource use; actions require applicable standing authorization.

levels.name: Dynamic Runtime Teams
levels.acceptance: Goal-derived temporary ARIES specialists run bounded planners with enforced grants, scoped context, shared budget reservations, durable dependencies, cancellation, independent verification and synthesis; single-agent ablation reported.

levels.name: Safe Slow Evolution
levels.acceptance: Sandboxed immutable policy candidates evaluated on baseline/ablation/held-out sets; safety and quality gates precede promotion; persisted active version can be atomically rolled back; crash rollback rehearsed; no evaluator or authority self-editing.

levels.name: Mature Personal Environment
levels.acceptance: All agreed supported journeys pass integrated acceptance and repeated reliability evaluation; unsupported/disconnected domains remain explicit; operation over specified observation window meets predeclared success, verification, privacy and efficiency SLOs.

promotion_rule: No efficiency gain counts if safety or verified task quality regresses. Unknown token/cost measurements remain unknown. Baseline and candidate use same fixture, reset, approved capabilities and independently implemented oracles.

example_boundaries.prepare_tomorrow: Calendar source adapter is not present in aries/connect; mail connector code exists but connectivity/authorization must be measured. Missing sources yield disclosed partial brief, never invented appointments.
example_boundaries.continue_project: Existing coding path generates bounded standard-library projects in a sandbox; arbitrary existing-project inspection/patch/test/rollback needs project-scoped worktree authority and independent acceptance tests.
